title: Brown Brothers Harriman, Versailles reparations and Union Bank financing of Hitler

tellings.quote: in 1924 George Herbert Walker leaves Brown Brothers Herman sets up the the Union Bank of New York completely capitalized by the guy who are part of Brown Brothers Herman

plain: Between the end of the First World War and 1939, according to a man named Dan Sheehan, American bankers turned the German war debts set by the Treaty of Versailles into a channel that helped pay for Hitler. He tells Michels that "in 1924 George Herbert Walker leaves Brown Brothers Harriman," a New York bank, and sets up the Union Bank of New York, "completely capitalized" by Brown Brothers Harriman partners. Sheehan says that bank funded the German industrialist Fritz Thyssen, and he ties in the American diplomat Robert Lansing and the Dulles brothers, John Foster and Allen. If true, leading American financiers helped finance the Nazi rise.
